# SurgeX

> AI-driven agency based in Lisbon, Portugal. We build bespoke AI solutions, premium websites, automation systems, and chatbots for businesses.

## About

SurgeX is a technology agency specializing in AI solutions for businesses. Founded by Sebastião Guimarães, we build every solution personally — the AI, the design, the backend. We serve businesses across all of Portugal, with 50+ projects delivered across 15+ niches including fitness, dental, beauty, veterinary, restaurants, auto detailing, home services, and more.

## Services

- Bespoke AI Solutions: custom AI systems, workshops, integration, and ongoing support
- Websites & Apps: premium custom-designed websites, SEO-optimized, mobile-ready, bilingual (PT/EN), delivered in 48 hours on average
- Automation & Chatbots: intelligent chatbots, automated follow-ups, email sequences, process automation — from 25€/month
- Digital Marketing: Google Ads, social media management, content creation, lead generation — all AI-powered
- GEO / AEO: Generative Engine Optimization — we help businesses appear in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews
- Training & Workshops: hands-on AI training for teams, prompt engineering, tool selection, workflow integration
